title: WebRL: Training LLM Web Agents via Self-Evolving Online Curriculum Reinforcement Learning
authors_zh: Zehan Qi、Xiao Liu、Iat Long Iong、Hanyu Lai、Xueqiao Sun、Wenyi Zhao、Yu Yang、Xinyue Yang、Jiadai Sun、Shuntian Yao、Tianjie Zhang、Wei Xu、Jie Tang、Yuxiao Dong
paper_type_zh: 网页智能体在线课程强化学习、结果奖励模型与轨迹构造研究
best_for_zh: 关注浏览器智能体、在线强化学习、trajectory data、learned verifier、经验回放和发布审计的研究者与工程人员
one_line: WebRL trains browser agents over 8 curriculum phases using failure-derived GPT-4o tasks, binary ORM-labeled rollouts, KL-constrained updates, and confidence-filtered successful replay, while releasing only a partial data corpus.
WebRL 从 1,186 条 WebArena-Lite 种子示范出发，以失败驱动课程、学习型 ORM 和成功轨迹回放训练浏览器智能体；方法证据充分，但完整在线语料与复用许可仍未发布。
why: It exposes how interactive agent trajectories become post-training records and shows that task generation, terminal reward modeling, and replay selection are inseparable parts of the feedback contract; it also illustrates why model/code release does not imply an auditable trajectory release.
inclusion_reason: WebRL is a concrete closed-loop browser-agent data recipe in which environment trajectories, a learned terminal judge, failure-conditioned task generation, and selective successful-experience replay jointly define the training signal.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Published at ICLR 2025, WebRL addresses a specific online-training bottleneck for open web agents: useful browser tasks are scarce, success feedback is sparse, and a policy can forget earlier skills as its own rollout distribution changes. The work is not a general open-web crawler or a static instruction-answer dataset. Its decision surface is a self-hosted WebArena-Lite episode in which a model observes simplified page HTML plus action history, emits browser actions, receives terminal feedback, and supplies future curriculum or replay data.

The seed side contains 1,186 WebArena-Lite training samples with an instruction, an oracle trajectory, and a reward function. Evaluation uses 165 held-out tasks over 5 sites: Reddit, GitLab, CMS, OpenStreetMap, and OneStopShop. This makes WebRL relevant to both environment-agent trajectory data and training-usage optimization: the trajectory is generated inside an evolving policy-environment loop, while selection, reward assignment, and replay determine which parts become supervision.

The evidence boundary is important. The paper, appendix, official code, model checkpoints, ORM checkpoint, external environment stack, and one SFT artifact are verifiable. The complete generated-task stream, raw success and failure trajectories, ORM labels, replay decisions, and historical environment snapshots are not released as an immutable corpus. The Card therefore documents a reconstructable method and a partial artifact release, not a fully reusable trajectory dataset.

WebRL 发表于 ICLR 2025，所解决的是开放网页智能体的一个具体在线训练瓶颈：可用浏览器任务稀缺、成功反馈稀疏，而且策略自身的 rollout 分布变化后容易遗忘早期能力。它不是通用开放网页爬取系统，也不是静态的指令—答案数据集。其决策对象是自托管 WebArena-Lite episode：模型读取简化后的页面 HTML 与动作历史，输出浏览器动作，获得终局反馈，并为后续课程生成或经验回放提供数据。

种子部分包含 1,186 条 WebArena-Lite 训练样本，每条具有指令、oracle 轨迹和 reward function；评测使用来自 Reddit、GitLab、CMS、OpenStreetMap 与 OneStopShop 这 5 个站点的 165 个留出任务。因此，WebRL 同时与环境—智能体轨迹数据和训练用法优化相关：轨迹产生于不断演化的策略—环境闭环，而筛选、奖励赋值和回放决定哪些部分真正成为监督信号。

这里必须守住证据边界。论文、附录、官方代码、actor checkpoint、ORM checkpoint、外部环境栈和一个 SFT 工件均可核验；完整的生成任务流、成功与失败原始轨迹、ORM 标签、回放选择记录及历史环境快照，并未以不可变语料形式发布。因此，本 Card 记录的是可重建的方法与部分工件发布，而不是可直接完整复用的轨迹数据集。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
WebRL's central contribution is to make data construction part of online policy optimization. Starting from 1,186 demonstrations, it alternates browser rollout collection, failure-conditioned task generation, learned outcome labeling, actor-critic updates, and successful-experience replay. Across 8 phases, each phase admits 500 filtered instructions whose difficulty is intended to match the current policy rather than a fixed task bank.

The feedback contract is mixed. WebArena-Lite reward functions label the original executable tasks and supervise construction of a 12,200-sample outcome-reward-model dataset. Newly generated tasks do not come with such executable checks; a learned ORM instead receives the instruction, full action history, and final HTML, then compares YES and NO probabilities to emit binary 1/0 reward. The verifier can observe the visible final page and recorded actions, but not hidden state, omitted earlier HTML, unintended side effects, or conditions absent from the final page.

Supervision attaches at several levels: terminal reward labels the episode, the critic estimates trajectory value for state-action updates, and actor confidence selects replay records. This differs from SFT or Filtered BC, which learn from fixed demonstrations, and from DigiRL, which performs online learning on a fixed task set. WebRL's direction signal is the coupling of failure-derived curriculum, learned terminal judgment, KL-constrained optimization, and selective replay; it is not evidence that the learned ORM is equivalent to an executable environment verifier.

WebRL 的核心贡献，是把数据构造直接纳入在线策略优化。从 1,186 条示范出发，它交替执行浏览器 rollout 收集、失败条件课程任务生成、学习型结果标注、actor-critic 更新和成功经验回放。在 8 个阶段中，每阶段接纳 500 条经筛选的指令，使任务难度尽量匹配当前策略，而不是沿用固定任务池。

其反馈契约是 mixed。WebArena-Lite reward function 为原始可执行任务提供标签，并用于构造含 12,200 条样本的结果奖励模型数据；新生成任务没有对应的可执行检查器，改由学习型 ORM 读取指令、完整动作历史和最终 HTML，再比较 YES 与 NO 的概率，输出二元 1/0 奖励。该 verifier 能观察可见的最终页面和已记录动作，却无法看到隐藏状态、被省略的早期 HTML、非预期副作用，或最终页面未呈现的任务条件。

监督信号附着在多个层级：terminal reward 标注整条 episode，critic 为 state-action 更新估计 trajectory value，actor confidence 则筛选回放记录。这不同于从固定示范学习的 SFT 或 Filtered BC，也不同于在固定任务集上在线训练的 DigiRL。WebRL 的方向价值来自失败驱动课程、学习型终局判断、KL 约束优化与选择性回放之间的耦合；它并不证明学习型 ORM 等价于可执行环境 verifier。

title: Method
方法
html:
The pipeline begins with 1,186 WebArena-Lite samples containing instructions, oracle trajectories, and reward functions. SFT initializes the actor; the critic copies that model and adds a randomly initialized value head. At each browser turn, the policy input contains the instruction, action history, and simplified current HTML with element IDs. The textual output is one browser operation such as Click, Type, Search, Scroll, tab control, navigation, or Exit.

Curriculum construction runs for 8 phases and retains 500 new instructions per phase. Failed instructions from prior interaction provide seeds to GPT-4o-2024-05-13. The released generator samples up to 10 seeds per site for 2 turns with random seed 42, temperature 1, and top_p 1. Generated instructions must pass a critic window from 0.05 to 0.75 and a GPT-4o feasibility screen. These code settings are verified, but exact end-to-end run seeds, retry behavior, total generations, and rollout multiplicity are not disclosed.

For feedback, original tasks use WebArena-Lite reward functions; those functions label augmented baseline and WebRL rollouts to train the ORM on 12,200 samples. For a generated task, the ORM compares YES and NO probabilities from the instruction, action history, and final HTML and assigns binary 1/0 reward. Processing code serializes step records with observation, next_observation, task, reward, done, action, and trajectory_reward; it can later add mc_return and rank_score. The current phase trains on both successful and failed labeled rollouts.

Historical replay is narrower. Only successful trajectories enter the buffer. The current actor computes action confidence, and records with probability above 0.5 and at most 0.95 are eligible; replay volume is capped at 2 times the current interaction-data size. Actor and critic then receive off-policy updates with a previous-policy KL constraint, discount factor 0.9, and GAE lambda 0.5. Failed trajectories are not replayed, but their instructions remain curriculum seeds.

Reported WebRL settings use actor and critic learning rates of 1e-6, batch size 128, and 1 epoch for each; ORM training uses learning rate 5e-6, 4 epochs, and cutoff length 16,384. Reproduction must also pin the external VAB-WebArena-Lite/browser/site state, task configurations, reset behavior, model revisions, and processing scripts. The paper does not disclose the maximum episode horizon or total environment compute, and the repository does not provide a turnkey historical run manifest.

流水线从 1,186 条 WebArena-Lite 样本开始，每条包含指令、oracle 轨迹和 reward function。SFT 用于初始化 actor；critic 复制该模型并增加随机初始化的 value head。每个浏览器回合中，策略输入由指令、动作历史以及带元素 ID 的简化当前 HTML 组成，文本输出则是 Click、Type、Search、Scroll、标签页控制、页面导航或 Exit 等单个浏览器操作。

课程构造运行 8 个阶段，每阶段保留 500 条新指令。此前交互中的失败指令作为 GPT-4o-2024-05-13 的种子；已发布生成器对每个站点最多抽取 10 条种子，运行 2 轮，随机种子为 42，temperature 为 1，top_p 为 1。生成指令还必须通过分数区间 0.05 到 0.75 的 critic 筛选和 GPT-4o 可行性检查。这些代码设置已经核验，但端到端实验种子、重试行为、总生成量和每条指令的 rollout 数量没有披露。

反馈方面，原始任务使用 WebArena-Lite reward function；这些函数给增强后的 baseline 与 WebRL rollout 打标签，从而构造含 12,200 条样本的 ORM 训练数据。对于生成任务，ORM 根据指令、动作历史和最终 HTML 比较 YES 与 NO 概率，并赋予二元 1/0 奖励。处理代码把每步序列化为 observation、next_observation、task、reward、done、action 和 trajectory_reward，后续还可加入 mc_return 与 rank_score。当前阶段训练同时使用成功和失败的已标注 rollout。

历史回放的范围更窄：只有成功轨迹进入 buffer。当前 actor 计算动作置信度，概率高于 0.5 且不超过 0.95 的记录才可进入回放，回放量最多为当前交互数据的 2 倍。随后 actor 与 critic 接受带前一阶段策略 KL 约束的 off-policy 更新，discount factor 为 0.9，GAE lambda 为 0.5。失败轨迹不回放，但其指令会继续作为课程种子。

论文报告的 WebRL 设置中，actor 与 critic 的学习率均为 1e-6，batch size 为 128，二者各训练 1 个 epoch；ORM 训练学习率为 5e-6，训练 4 个 epoch，cutoff length 为 16,384。复现还必须固定外部 VAB-WebArena-Lite、浏览器与站点状态、任务配置、reset 行为、模型 revision 和处理脚本。论文没有披露 episode 最大 horizon 或总环境计算量，仓库也没有提供可直接重放历史实验的完整 run manifest。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On the 165-task WebArena-Lite evaluation set, the paper reports that Llama-3.1-8B rises from 4.8% to 42.4% average success rate and GLM-4-9B rises from 6.1% to 43.0%. WebRL-Llama-3.1-70B reaches 49.1%. Under the reported setup, these exceed GPT-4-Turbo at 17.6%, GPT-4o at 13.9%, and AutoWebGLM at 18.2%. These are author-reported results for one self-hosted benchmark configuration, not independent reproduction or evidence of open-web deployment reliability. (Table 1)

The learned ORM is evaluated on WebArena-Lite test records and 100 manually labeled rollouts. The paper reports approximately 80% accuracy, while compared baselines are slightly above 70%. This supports using the ORM as a nontrivial outcome proxy, but it leaves roughly one-fifth error at aggregate level and provides no complete per-site calibration, adversarial evaluation, or public prediction log. (Section 3.8)

Ablations attribute the final result to all three coupled components: curriculum learning, KL-constrained update, and replay. Removing replay causes performance to worsen across phases; too-low or too-high replay confidence is inferior to the middle band; adding failed histories to replay yields slower and more volatile learning because terminal failure can penalize locally correct actions. Across 4 random-seed runs, the overall trend rises but fluctuates. The Map site declines late and GitLab dips slightly, so average improvement hides cross-site interference over the 8 phases. These negative results are especially relevant to trajectory selection and reward assignment.

在包含 165 个任务的 WebArena-Lite 评测集上，论文报告 Llama-3.1-8B 的平均成功率从 4.8% 提升至 42.4%，GLM-4-9B 从 6.1% 提升至 43.0%，WebRL-Llama-3.1-70B 达到 49.1%。在论文所述设置下，这些结果高于 17.6% 的 GPT-4-Turbo、13.9% 的 GPT-4o 和 18.2% 的 AutoWebGLM。它们是作者在单一自托管 benchmark 配置上的报告值，并非独立复现，也不能证明开放网页部署可靠性。（Table 1）

学习型 ORM 在 WebArena-Lite 测试记录和 100 条人工标注 rollout 上接受评测。论文报告其准确率约为 80%，对比 baseline 略高于 70%。这说明 ORM 可以充当非平凡的结果代理，但总体上仍约有五分之一误差，而且论文没有给出完整的分站点校准、对抗评测或公开预测日志。（Section 3.8）

消融实验把最终结果归因于课程学习、KL 约束更新和 replay 三个耦合组件。移除 replay 后，性能会随阶段推进而恶化；过低或过高的回放置信度均不如中间区间；把失败历史加入 replay 会让训练更慢、波动更大，因为终局失败可能惩罚局部正确动作。4 组随机种子实验总体趋势上升但存在波动；在 8 个阶段中，Map 后期下降，GitLab 也略有回落，说明平均提升掩盖了跨站点干扰。这些负面结果对轨迹筛选和奖励归因尤其重要。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier web-agent training work represented by SFT and Filtered BC relies on fixed demonstrations, while DigiRL brings online reinforcement learning to a fixed task collection. WebRL changes the data interface rather than merely increasing model size: failure instructions become task-generation seeds, task difficulty is filtered into a 0.05-to-0.75 critic window, current-policy browser episodes receive learned terminal feedback, and only successful historical records in the 0.5-to-0.95 actor-confidence band are replayed.

The distinctive object is therefore not a single trajectory but a phase-indexed lineage linking failed instruction, generated instruction, initial site state, actor rollout, ORM label, critic estimate, replay decision, and later policy revision. Running 8 phases with 500 retained tasks each turns construction and selection into policy-dependent processes. This is a useful direction signal for reasoning-data research because task source, judge, optimizer, and retention rule co-evolve; auditing only the final checkpoint or the accepted traces would miss the causal data pipeline.

Individual ingredients are not new in isolation: SFT initialization, GPT-4o generation, binary reward modeling, actor-critic learning, KL regularization, and experience replay all have prior lineages. The contribution is their WebArena-specific closed-loop integration plus empirical analysis of forgetting, confidence filtering, and failed replay. Reuse still requires the missing manifests, exact environment state, ORM audit, and rights information; the released models and code do not by themselves make the underlying curriculum data reproducible.

以 SFT 和 Filtered BC 为代表的早期网页智能体训练依赖固定示范，而 DigiRL 把在线强化学习用于固定任务集合。WebRL 改变的是数据接口，而不只是扩大模型规模：失败指令变成任务生成种子，任务难度通过 0.05 到 0.75 的 critic 区间筛选，当前策略浏览器 episode 接受学习型终局反馈，历史记录中只有成功且 actor confidence 位于 0.5 到 0.95 区间的部分才被回放。

因此，独特的数据对象不是单条轨迹，而是一条按阶段组织的 lineage：失败指令、生成指令、初始站点状态、actor rollout、ORM 标签、critic 估计、replay 决策和后续策略版本彼此相连。运行 8 个阶段且每阶段保留 500 个任务，使构造与筛选都依赖当前策略。这对 reasoning data 研究具有方向价值，因为任务来源、judge、optimizer 和保留规则共同演化；若只审计最终 checkpoint 或被接纳的轨迹，就会遗漏形成结果的数据因果链。

各个组件单独来看并非新创：SFT 初始化、GPT-4o 生成、二元奖励建模、actor-critic 学习、KL 正则和经验回放都有已有脉络。本文的贡献在于面向 WebArena 的闭环整合，以及对遗忘、置信度筛选和失败回放的实证分析。复用前仍需补齐缺失 manifest、精确环境状态、ORM 审计和权利信息；仅有模型与代码发布，并不能使底层课程数据自动可复现。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The primary modeling limitation is the ORM. Its binary 1/0 decision is based on instruction, action history, and final HTML, so a visually plausible final page can hide failed side effects, unmet conditions, or state not serialized into HTML. Approximately 80% aggregate accuracy on the reported evaluation, including 100 manual rollouts, permits both false positives and false negatives. Because the optimized policy supplies part of the ORM training distribution, shared blind spots and reward gaming remain plausible curator-inferred risks.

Release completeness is substantially weaker than method disclosure. The roughly 103 MB scripts/webarena_lite_sft.pt file is one PyTorch-serialized SFT/experience artifact; it is not the complete record of 8 phases by 500 retained tasks. Generated instructions, raw success and failure trajectories, ORM outputs, replay selections, failure sets, environment logs, and seed manifests are absent. Successful histories enter replay while failed histories are dropped from replay, so a released accepted-only view would conceal selection bias even if it later became available.

Split and contamination evidence is partial. The named split uses 1,186 training samples and 165 evaluation tasks over the same 5 sites, but generated tasks intentionally inherit domains and variable values from failures. Without an item-level lineage and similarity analysis, template or entity overlap with evaluation cannot be audited. The paper also does not report model-pretraining decontamination.

Rights and replay create separate blockers. The repository has no root license, the model cards say license: other, and the external VisualAgentBench Apache-2.0 license does not cover WebRL's whole release. The .pt file has no verified standalone data license and is consumed through torch.load; as a curator-inferred security precaution, it should be inspected as untrusted serialization in isolation. Browser traces may contain usernames, account state, HTML, and action history, yet no redaction, consent, retention, or takedown policy was verified. Finally, historical site images, credentials, reset order, browser version, and maximum episode horizon are not pinned, making exact replay unverified.

首要建模限制来自 ORM。它只根据指令、动作历史和最终 HTML 给出二元 1/0 判断，因此表面合理的最终页面仍可能掩盖失败副作用、未满足条件，或未序列化进 HTML 的状态。论文所述评测包含 100 条人工 rollout，ORM 总体准确率约为 80%，这意味着 false positive 与 false negative 均可能存在。由于被优化策略提供了部分 ORM 训练分布，共享盲点与 reward gaming 是合理但属于 curator inference 的风险。

发布完整性明显弱于方法披露。约 103 MB 的 scripts/webarena_lite_sft.pt 只是一个 PyTorch 序列化的 SFT/experience 工件，并不是 8 个阶段、每阶段 500 个保留任务的完整记录。生成指令、成功与失败原始轨迹、ORM 输出、replay 选择、failure set、环境日志和种子 manifest 均未发布。成功历史进入 replay，失败历史则从 replay 中丢弃；即使未来只发布接纳样本，也会隐藏这种选择偏差。

split 与污染证据仍不完整。具名划分包含 1,186 条训练样本和 165 个评测任务，覆盖相同的 5 个站点；但生成任务会刻意继承失败样本的领域和值。缺少逐条 lineage 与相似度分析时，无法审计模板或实体是否与评测重叠。论文也没有报告模型预训练去污染。

权利与 replay 构成另外两类阻塞。仓库没有根许可证，模型卡标为 license: other，外部 VisualAgentBench 的 Apache-2.0 许可证也不覆盖整个 WebRL 发布；.pt 文件没有经核验的独立数据许可，而且通过 torch.load 读取。作为 curator inference 的安全预防，应在隔离环境中把它当作不可信序列化对象检查。浏览器轨迹可能包含用户名、账户状态、HTML 和动作历史，但未核验到脱敏、同意、保留或下架政策。历史站点镜像、凭据、reset 顺序、浏览器版本和 episode 最大 horizon 同样未固定，因此精确重放尚未得到验证。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
WebRL is most reusable today as a construction and audit reference. A builder can reconstruct the separation among 1,186 SFT seeds, the 12,200-sample ORM dataset, current-policy rollouts, failure-conditioned generation, mixed environment/ORM feedback, and successful-only replay. The disclosed 8-phase by 500-task curriculum and the 0.05-to-0.75 task filter provide concrete baselines for testing whether adaptive task difficulty improves over a fixed task bank.

The replay design is also a useful controlled experiment: compare all histories, successful-only histories, and the released 0.5-to-0.95 confidence band while preserving terminal labels and local action diagnostics. Verifier research can reproduce the ORM input restriction, then add hidden-state checks, per-site calibration, adversarial final pages, and disagreement with executable predicates. Evaluation reuse should keep the 165-task holdout separate and freeze the full browser/site/reset stack.

Training-data reuse is blocked pending verification. The roughly 103 MB .pt artifact lacks a standalone license and does not contain the complete curriculum lineage; loading it also requires isolated inspection because of torch.load. The public checkpoints can support method comparison subject to their upstream terms, but they do not license or reconstruct the missing trajectories. Until task rights, full success/failure retention, ORM labels, split overlap, and environment versions are released, the safe class is reading/audit reference and reproduction scaffold, not a drop-in SFT or online-RL corpus.

WebRL 当前最适合作为构造与审计参考。研究者可以据此重建 1,186 条 SFT 种子、含 12,200 条样本的 ORM 数据、当前策略 rollout、失败条件生成、mixed 环境/ORM 反馈和仅成功轨迹 replay 之间的区分。论文披露的 8 阶段、每阶段 500 个任务课程，以及 0.05 到 0.75 的任务筛选区间，为检验自适应任务难度是否优于固定任务池提供了具体 baseline。

其 replay 设计也适合做受控实验：比较全部历史、仅成功历史和论文采用的 0.5 到 0.95 置信区间，同时保留 terminal label 与局部动作诊断。Verifier 研究可以复现 ORM 的输入限制，再增加隐藏状态检查、分站点校准、对抗性最终页面，以及与可执行 predicate 的分歧分析。评测复用应严格隔离包含 165 个任务的 holdout，并冻结完整浏览器、站点与 reset 栈。

训练数据复用目前处于 blocked pending verification。约 103 MB 的 .pt 工件没有独立许可，也不包含完整课程 lineage；由于使用 torch.load，加载前还需隔离检查。公开 checkpoint 在遵循上游条款的前提下可支持方法比较，但既不能授权，也不能重建缺失轨迹。在任务权利、完整成功/失败留存、ORM 标签、split overlap 和环境版本公开之前，安全复用等级应是 reading/audit reference 与 reproduction scaffold，而不是可直接投入 SFT 或在线 RL 的语料。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Start with the data boundary: 1,186 WebArena-Lite seed samples and 12,200 ORM samples are described, but the complete online curriculum corpus is not released.
  • Read Algorithm 1 with Appendix B: 8 phases each retain 500 tasks, current rollouts train the policy, successful trajectories enter replay, and failed instructions seed later generation.
  • Keep the feedback contract mixed: executable WebArena-Lite rewards supervise original tasks and ORM construction; the learned ORM judges generated tasks from action history and final HTML.
  • Treat the roughly 103 MB .pt as a partial, unlicensed, serialized SFT artifact, not as all trajectories; inspect it in isolation before torch.load.
  • Pair the headline scores with the 165-task split, ORM error, cross-site regression, missing overlap manifest, missing failure corpus, and unpinned environment state.

• 先确认数据边界：论文描述了 1,186 条 WebArena-Lite 种子样本和 12,200 条 ORM 样本，但完整在线课程语料没有发布。
  • 将 Algorithm 1 与 Appendix B 对照阅读：8 个阶段各保留 500 个任务；当前 rollout 用于训练策略，成功轨迹进入 replay，失败指令则成为后续生成种子。
  • 始终把反馈契约视为 mixed：可执行 WebArena-Lite reward 监督原始任务和 ORM 构造，学习型 ORM 则依据动作历史与最终 HTML 判断生成任务。
  • 把约 103 MB 的 .pt 看作部分、无独立许可的序列化 SFT 工件，而非全部轨迹；执行 torch.load 前应在隔离环境检查。
  • 阅读 headline score 时同时核对 165 个任务的 split、ORM 误差、跨站点回退、缺失的 overlap manifest、缺失的失败语料和未固定环境状态。
